episode_title: Storm Postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade, Trump's New Tariffs, Iowa Post-Detonation
script_en: Storm Postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade, Trump's New Tariffs, Iowa Post-Detonation.
Powerful storms threaten to disrupt Thanksgiving travel for millions of Americans and have forced the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade to be postponed for the first time in its history.
The Trump administration is proposing new tariffs on goods from fourteen major trading partners, setting up another potential legal fight over the president’s trade policies.

The Army is calling its controlled detonation of unstable explosives in Iowa a success, but some residents are waiting for independent test results before trusting assurances about lead contamination.
